description: Parses and checks an FXServer server.cfg: syntax, argument counts and values, duplicate or conflicting settings, repeated resource starts, framework and ox resource start order, missing dependencies, OneSync/slot conflicts, secrets exposed with set/sets, weak RCON passwords, plain-text database passwords and placeholder values. Returns issues with line numbers and a suggested fix. The config is processed in memory and never stored; secret values are never echoed.
name: validate_server_cfg
title: Validate server.cfg
